findings.summary: Yellow brand and hero text has insufficient contrast against white and cream backgrounds.
findings.fix: Replace #edb43a with a darker text color that reaches at least 3:1 on the hero cream and white header backgrounds.
findings.evidence: #edb43a measures 1.88:1 on #fff and 1.78:1 on #fff8eb; both uses are large text and require 3:1.

findings.summary: Several input and select boundaries are too low-contrast to identify the controls against white backgrounds.
findings.fix: Darken the borders for form fields, search fields, selects and URL inputs so their boundaries reach at least 3:1 against adjacent backgrounds.
findings.evidence: #ded4c7 against white is 1.46:1; --line (#e7dccb) against white is 1.36:1.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is visually suppressed on both product-search inputs.
findings.fix: Restore a visible focus outline on the search inputs, or provide an equally visible :focus-visible style on their wrappers.
findings.evidence: Both input :focus-visible rules set outline: none.

findings.summary: Route changes move focus to the main element, but its focus indicator is removed.
findings.fix: Provide a visible focus style for main instead of outline: none.
findings.evidence: mainRef.current.focus() targets the tabindex=-1 main element; main:focus removes the outline.
